Discipline

Design Engineering

Design engineering is the discipline of owning both design and code — not handing off from one to the other, but doing both in the same hands. Every handoff introduces drift. Design engineering removes that variable.

How I work

Design to code,
no translation loss.

Figma to production fidelity

Components, variants, auto-layout, and prototypes built at the same resolution as the final product. Not approximations — exact.

Framer for marketing & landing pages

From design to live in days, not weeks. Framer sites that move, respond, and actually look like the Figma.

React for product front-ends

Custom front-end logic when the product demands it. AI-assisted where it accelerates, hand-coded where precision matters.

No handoff

The same person who designed it ships it. Fewer misinterpretations, fewer revision cycles, faster time to working product.

Why it matters

Most product teams ship a design, hand it off, and watch it drift in implementation. Developers interpret intent. Designers can't review every edge case. The result is a product that sort of looks like the design — and requires rounds of revision to close the gap.

I close that loop by being the single point of contact for design and front-end. The code I ship looks like the design because I wrote both. No interpretation layer — what you see in Figma is what ships.
